prior_narrative.tldr: This page mechanically groups three items that share the phrase "large language models" in their title, not one developing story. It runs from an HVAC deployment review to a Zhipu/MiniMax business-model roundup to a medical-hallucination detector, with nothing connecting them but that phrase.
prior_narrative.whats_new: The newest item is still Sep 10's domain-specific hallucination detector combining fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 classification with Monte Carlo sampling; the SwarmBench agent-orchestration paper previously on this page has aged out of the window.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Ranking-by-shared-title-phrase can silently fold unrelated arxiv papers and business news into one page -- treat this grouping as noise, not corroboration, before citing more than one item from it together.
